title: Prompt
subtitle: A voice-first AI literacy game that teaches kids to spot the frame before it spots them.

decision.question: How do you keep an LLM judge's scores consistent across turns?

rejected.option: Let the LLM grade every answer
rejected.why: The same response can receive different scores across runs

chosen.option: Use a deterministic rule engine with one tightly-scoped LLM exception
chosen.why: Rules keep scores consistent; the judge can only promote novel bias-inverter reframes
